tasks.instruction_text: Search for a new internal M.2 Samsung SSD drive between $25 and $200. Use the Price filter — type the min in the left box and the max in the right box, then hit Set.
Cap the price at $200 so I only see Samsung M.2 SSDs at or below that — leave the min blank.
I want to skip the cheap stuff — set the minimum price to $90 on the Samsung 9100 PRO SSD results and leave the max blank.
Find new Samsung M.2 SSDs from $60 to $330 that I can actually buy today — set the price range AND check the 'In stock' availability box.
Cap the max price at $200. What's the cheapest Samsung M.2 SSD that comes back, and what does it cost?
Set the price range from $25 to $200 AND check the 4+ stars customer rating box. How many Samsung M.2 SSDs match?
Filter to Samsung M.2 SSDs priced between $50 and $300. Which one has the highest customer rating and what is its rating?
I need a new Samsung M.2 SSD from $100 to $500 with free shipping, and it has to be in stock. Apply all three filters.
Set the floor at $25 and the ceiling at $100 on the Samsung 9100 PRO SSD results — list the count of Samsung M.2 SSDs in that band.
Cap the price between $200 and $700 and check the 4+ stars box. Of the matches, which Samsung M.2 SSD has the largest capacity?
